messages.content: Help me create a mapping that assigns each of the first 4 elements from a given array to the category 'transition' for use in CSS transitions?

function.name: mapTransitions
function.description: This function creates a mapping where each key is an element from a given array (up to a specified limit of elements) and each value is set to a predefined category. This is useful for defining categories for CSS transitions. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

category.description: The category to be assigned to each element in the mapping. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

limit.description: The number of elements from the array to include in the mapping. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.
